title: Nanoplastics as carriers of organic pollutants in seawater-saturated porous media: a quantitative comparison of transport pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00489F, Paper
Yuanzhang Hou, Yange Wang, Yuchen Tang, Yuping Qiu
The inhibited migration of non-polar organic pollutants in seawater-saturated porous media is primarily attributed to the carrier effect of nanoplastics.
